analysis.summary: Users must be able to log in with valid credentials to reach the inventory page; invalid or empty credentials must trigger an error and keep the user on the login page.

explicit_requirements.statement: Users must be able to log in to SauceDemo using valid credentials and reach the inventory page.
explicit_requirements.source_quote: Users must be able to log in to SauceDemo using valid credentials and reach the inventory page.

explicit_requirements.statement: Given standard_user / secret_sauce, the user is taken to the inventory page.
explicit_requirements.source_quote: Given standard_user / secret_sauce, the user is taken to the inventory page.

explicit_requirements.statement: Given invalid credentials, an error message is displayed and the user stays on the login page.
explicit_requirements.source_quote: Given invalid credentials, an error message is displayed and the user stays on the login page.

explicit_requirements.statement: Given empty username or password, an error message is displayed.
explicit_requirements.source_quote: Given empty username or password, an error message is displayed.

scenarios.title: Successful login with valid credentials navigates to inventory page
scenarios.basis: Derived from FR-2 and FR-1; valid credentials should allow access to inventory page.

scenarios.title: Login attempt with invalid credentials shows error and remains on login page
scenarios.basis: Derived from FR-3; invalid credentials must be rejected with error.

scenarios.title: Login attempt with empty username shows error
scenarios.basis: Derived from FR-4; empty username must trigger error.

scenarios.title: Login attempt with empty password shows error
scenarios.basis: Derived from FR-4; empty password must trigger error.

potentially_missed_scenarios.title: Login with other valid user accounts
potentially_missed_scenarios.rationale: The requirement mentions only standard_user / secret_sauce; other valid users may exist.

potentially_missed_scenarios.title: Login with whitespace-only username or password
potentially_missed_scenarios.rationale: Behavior for inputs containing only spaces is not defined.

potentially_missed_scenarios.title: Case sensitivity of username and password
Account lockout after multiple failed attempts
potentially_missed_scenarios.rationale: Security handling for repeated invalid logins is not specified.

missing_information: List of all valid user credentials
Password complexity or case sensitivity rules
ambiguities: Definition of "invalid credentials" (wrong username, wrong password, or both)
Whether empty username and empty password are handled identically
assumptions: standard_user / secret_sauce are the only valid credentials for the positive scenario
analysis.validation_notes: All explicit requirements are directly quoted from the user text; scenarios are logically derived from those requirements without adding new rules.
